In summary, our research is concerned with
the chiral dynamics in the mesonic sector of QCD and its consequences for the low-energy hadron physics.
a consistent and complete study of the low-energy QCD dynamics in the scalar and pseudscalar sectors.

the chiral dynamics in the scalar and pseudocalar sectors and the corresponding resonance spectrum, which is a prerequisite for a better understanding of the scalar meson spectroscopy and its relation to the underlying QCD dynamics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
chiral perturbation is a very useful framework for the study of the scalar sector and its dynamics.
the meson-meson interaction and the scalar and pseudocalar form factors can be understood within the U(3) framework with the explicit inclusion of the lowest lying scalar and vector resonances.
the U(3) model with resonances and the U(3)xU(3) chPT model with resonances are in good agreement with the data and that the latter can be used as an alternative to the U(3xNc) model with resonaces.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the scalar resonances can be understood as the chiral partners of the vector resonances and the pseudoscalar mesons.

we are able to reproduce the experimental data for the scalar and pseudocalar form factors, the scattering data and the spectral functions in the scalar and pseudscalar sectors as well as the sum rules and semi-local dually in the scalar and vector sectors with a very small set of parameters.
the one-loop calculation with explicit resonances provides an excellent description for all the above mentioned quantities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the scalar resonances are not only needed to describe the scalar form factors, the scalar spectral functions and semi-local dality, but also the scattering amplitudes in the scalar sector.
the chiral Lagrangians with explicit resonance exchanges provide a good phenomenological description of the scalar and vector meson spectra and their couplings.
the scalar and pseudocalar sectors are deeply interrelated and that the scalar resonances are crucial for a proper understanding of the pseudoscalar ones.
